TEST1001 Introduction to Economics
Week 01 Lecture Notes

Topic: Markets and Opportunity Cost

A market is a setting where buyers and sellers exchange goods, services, or information. The demo model uses a simple demand schedule and supply schedule to show how price adjusts when there is excess demand or excess supply.

Key idea:
Opportunity cost is the value of the best alternative that is given up when a choice is made.

Example:
If a student spends two hours revising economics instead of working a casual shift, the opportunity cost includes the forgone wage and any other valued alternative use of that time.

Source note:
This is synthetic demo content created for StudyHub Local. It is not copied from any university course.
